purpose: Measure how task-sufficient block reporting scales against per-channel 4-bit soft power as the channel grid and fixed contiguous demand grow.
demand_rounding: all selected channel counts are divisible by four; demand_channels = exact ratio times n_channels

representations.name: soft_power_fixed4
representations.description: four-bit min-max-normalized mean power for every channel

representations.name: best_block_onehot
representations.description: current C1-v4 one-hot best-block indicator with zero at the selected candidate

representations.name: best_block_binary_index
representations.description: development-only compact integer index of the best candidate block

statistics.comparison: proposed minus four-bit soft power within each N,D task

descriptive_targets.interpretation: A task reaches the strong scalability target only when actual-bit reduction is at least 20% and mean regret is noninferior to soft power.

claim_boundary: Fixed-task scaling on already-seen AERPAW development sweeps and a simulated reporting link. It does not alter the consumed Final, confirm the compact index, or establish dynamic-demand, mobility, MIMO, measured-backhaul, or cross-dataset generalization.
